name: Feedback, Notifications & Messaging
description: Feedback, Notifications & Messaging standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-FEEDBACK applies.

rules.title: Choose feedback surface by scope and urgency
rules.detail: Use inline feedback for field/local issues, toast for lightweight transient confirmation, persistent banner for ongoing/global conditions, and dialog only when blocking decision is required.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Choose feedback surface by scope and urgency.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Choose feedback surface by scope and urgency.

rules.title: Never display raw backend or exception messages to users
rules.detail: Map stable error codes/types to safe localized user messages and log technical detail with correlation separately.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Never display raw backend or exception messages to users.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Never display raw backend or exception messages to users.

rules.title: Make actionable failures explain next steps
rules.detail: Messages state what happened in user terms and, when possible, provide retry, correction or support action.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make actionable failures explain next steps.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make actionable failures explain next steps.

rules.title: Avoid success noise for obvious actions
rules.detail: Do not toast every successful interaction when the resulting UI state already clearly confirms the action.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Avoid success noise for obvious actions.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Avoid success noise for obvious actions.

rules.title: Persist important state until resolved
rules.detail: Offline, account restriction, unsaved changes or other ongoing conditions must not disappear as transient toasts.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Persist important state until resolved.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Persist important state until resolved.

rules.title: Make feedback accessible
rules.detail: Dynamic messages use appropriate live-region/focus behavior and do not rely on color, icon or animation alone.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make feedback accessible.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make feedback accessible.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-FEEDBACK applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Feedback, Notifications & Messaging to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Raw API message is shown in a toast
common_issues.cause: Transport/technical messages are treated as UX copy.
common_issues.solution: Map stable error codes to safe localized feedback and log technical details separately.

common_issues.issue: Persistent failure disappears after a few seconds
common_issues.cause: A transient toast is used for an ongoing condition.
common_issues.solution: Use persistent inline/banner/dialog feedback based on scope and required action.
